tagline: Leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company creating value through superior service, quality products, and personalized solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Water Treatment segment is the company's primary growth driver, contributing 23% of the sales increase in 2025, driven by strategic acquisitions (Amerochem, Waterguard, Wofford, Intercoastal) and a 5% volume increase in the historical business.

kpis.name: Water treatment segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Sales generated from the supply of products and services for drinking water, wastewater, and pools.
kpis.description: The segment experienced strong growth thanks to four acquisitions in 2025 and a 5% volume increase in the historical business.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by acquisitions and domestic demand

kpis.name: Industrial segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Sales of industrial chemicals for agriculture, energy, pharmaceuticals, and other industries.
kpis.description: Despite a slight volume increase, sales declined due to lower selling prices on certain products.
kpis.signal: Decline linked to pricing pressure and product mix

kpis.name: Health and nutrition segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Sales of salts, food ingredients, and pharmaceutical-grade products.
kpis.description: Growth in distributed products offsets the decline in manufactured products, notably a low-margin product.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin after cost of sales, expressed as a percentage of sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves from 21.1% to 23.1%, supported by lower raw material prices and a positive LIFO effect of 1.6 million.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement driven by cost management and LIFO

kpis.name: Operating income
kpis.explanation: Profit before interest and taxes as a percentage of sales.
kpis.description: Operating margin improves thanks to Water Treatment segment growth and better operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total sales of the company.
kpis.description: Total sales reach 974.4M$, up 55.2M$ compared to 2024, primarily driven by the Water Treatment segment.

kpis.name: Share of bulk products in sales
kpis.explanation: Percentage of sales represented by unprocessed bulk products.
kpis.description: Estimated at approximately 12% of total (9% in Water Treatment, 15% in Industrial), these products carry the lowest margins.
kpis.signal: Low margin, indicator of competitive pressure

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.77 B€ in the latest year

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive environment with larger and more powerful competitors, which could affect its market share and profit margins.

risks.title: Product risks and liability
risks.score_rationale: The company's products may be subject to recalls or litigation in case of defects or non-compliance, which could negatively impact the company's reputation and finances.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to cyberattacks and data loss, which could compromise information confidentiality and harm the company's reputation.

risks.title: Raw material price fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in raw material prices can negatively impact the company's profit margins, particularly if costs rise faster than selling prices.

risks.title: Environmental risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to environmental risks related to the production and handling of chemicals, which could result in significant costs and harm to the company's reputation.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions can negatively impact the company's production and sales, particularly if suppliers are affected by external events.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or advanced digital solutions in the provided documents. The company focuses on specialty chemicals, water treatment services, and acquisitions for growth.
